paper.title: Keck Observations in the INfrared of Taurus and ρ Oph Exoplanets And Ultracool dwarfs (KOINTREAU) I: A Planetary-Mass Companion and a Disk-Obscured Stellar Companion Discovered in Taurus

notes: Host is an M4 Taurus member (~3.3 Myr, XEST/XMM-Newton survey source). KOINTREAU-1b was confirmed bound via common proper motion with Gaia astrometry (log Bayes factor ~25.7; Walker+2026). The companion's spectral type varies between epochs (M7 SpeX vs L1 GNIRS), possibly indicating clouds or a circumcompanion disk.
